questions.prompt: A person using a laptop typically cares a lot about resource utilization.
Why must the OS on a mainframe care more about resource utilization than the OS on a personal laptop?
options: Mainframes run only one program at a time
Many users share one machine, so the OS must keep all of them happy

questions.prompt: Phones and tablets are described as resource poor. What do their operating systems optimize for?
options: Running as many users as possible at once

"Controls the execution of programs to prevent errors and improper use of the computer." Which role is that?
A workstation has dedicated resources but frequently uses shared resources from servers.
